authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 5731 tala explicitly includes “palm, sole” and adverbial tale/tare “below”. The simple survey tal/taṛe/tel forms preserve that family, while initial aspiration or an n-bearing stem needs distinguishing alternative formations. Reviewed comparator: Bshk tīl “palm” (f_54bm42vka4fzo). Any uncertain transfer between Indo-Aryan languages remains open under the user’s preference; source phonetic details are preserved.
